title: HELIOS GitHub milestone manifest (config/github/milestones.json)
description: The shape scripts/github/apply-milestones.ps1 reads: an object { $comment, milestones: [...] } or a bare array of entries. An entry carries exactly title / description / due_on - the script marks any other key (dueOn, state, descr) INVALID (exit 1) - so entries are closed here too. due_on is a calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD; the script sends noon UTC and compares by UTC date); omit it to leave the live due date unmanaged - the script never clears one. Do not add a $schema key to the manifest: the bare-array form cannot carry one and the object form is wired to this schema through .vscode/settings.json json.schemas instead.

title.description: Matched against live milestones case-insensitively; a PATCH never renames.

due_on.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD (a real one: 2026-02-30 fails). Omit to leave the live due date unmanaged.
